source: raw header order of control-plane replies (content-type from the body's media type comes after connection; ResponseWriter's own replaceHeader puts it first)

steps.note: one expectation to retrieve, a fixed id so the raw bodies compare

tcp.text:
GET /a HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Connection: close

steps.note: one request to retrieve, a fixed Host so the raw bodies compare

tcp.text:
PUT /mockserver/retrieve?type=ACTIVE_EXPECTATIONS HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 0
Connection: close

steps.note: retrieve expectations as JSON: withBody(..., MediaType), content-type after connection

tcp.text:
PUT /mockserver/retrieve?type=ACTIVE_EXPECTATIONS&format=java HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 0
Connection: close

PUT /mockserver/retrieve?type=REQUESTS HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 0
Connection: close

PUT /mockserver/retrieve?type=LOGS HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 24
Connection: close

{"path":"/no-such-path"}

steps.note: retrieve logs (text) of a filter nothing matches

tcp.text:
PUT /mockserver/expectation HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 71
Connection: close

{"id":"0868-b","httpRequest":{"path":"/b"},"httpResponse":{"body":"y"}}
